messages.author: 12a049f5b9449ef7
messages.subject: Error warning when doing a cfa
parts:
Hi there,

I am doing my first steps with R and trying to do a cfa with the results from an already established questionnaire.
After specifying the model with its six latent variables and differing numbers of indicators respectively, I wanted to fit it and received the following error warning:
Error in lav_syntax_parse_rhs(rhs = rhs.formula[[2L]], op = op) :
lavaan ERROR: I'm confused parsing this line: $SJTSHH_SIN01
Additional: There were 14 warnings (displayed with warnings())

The script reads as follows, thus, the error is already related to the very first line or the first indicator:


HEXACO.Modell <- ' HH =~ SJTS$HH_SIN01 + SJTS$HH_FAI01 + SJTS$HH_GRE01 + SJTS$HH_MOD01
+ SJTS$HH_SIN02 + SJTS$HH_FAI02 + SJTS$HH_GRE02 + SJTS$HH_MOD02
+ SJTS$HH_SIN03 + SJTS$HH_FAI03 + SJTS$HH_SIN04 + SJTS$HH_FAI04
+ SJTS$HH_GRE04 + SJTS$HH_MOD03 + SJTS$HH_MOD04
E =~ SJTS$E_FEAR01 + SJTS$E_ANX01 + SJTS$E_DEP01 + SJTS$E_FEAR02
+ SJTS$E_ANX02 + SJTS$E_DEP02 + SJTS$E_SENT02 + SJTS$E_FEAR03
+ SJTS$E_SENT03
EX =~ SJTS$EX_SSE01 + SJTS$EX_SB01 + SJTS$EX_SOC01 + SJTS$EX_LIV01
+ SJTS$EX_SSE02 + SJTS$EX_SB02 + SJTS$EX_SOC02 + SJTS$EX_LIV02
+ SJTS$EX_SSE03 + SJTS$EX_SB03
A =~ SJTS$A_FORG01 + SJTS$A_GENT01 + SJTS$A_FLEX01 + SJTS$A_PAT01
+ SJTS$A_FORG02 + SJTS$A_GENT02 + SJTS$A_GENT03 + SJTS$A_FLEX02
+ SJTS$A_PAT02 + SJTS$A_PAT03 + SJTS$A_FORG03 + SJTS$A_FLEX03
+ SJTS$A_FORG04 + SJTS$A_GENT04 + SJTS$A_FLEX04 + SJTS$A_PAT04
C =~ SJTS$C_ORG01 + SJTS$C_DIL01 + SJTS$C_PERF01 + SJTS$C_PRU01
+ SJTS$C_ORG02 + SJTS$C_DIL02 + SJTS$C_PERF02 + SJTS$C_PRU02
+ SJTS$C_PERF03 + SJTS$C_PRU03
O =~ SJTS$O_AES01 + SJTS$O_INQ01 + SJTS$O_CREA01 + SJTS$O_UNC01
+ SJTS$O_AES02 + SJTS$O_INQ02 + SJTS$O_CREA02 + SJTS$O_UNC02
+ SJTS$O_CREA03 + SJTS$O_UNC03 '

#Modell fitten
fit <- cfa(HEXACO.Modell, data=BereinigterDatensatz0904)


I´d appreaciate any help or hint where to search further - thank you!

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Error warning when doing a cfa
parts:
You are using variable names of the form
  SJTS$HH_SIN01 
In R, a dollar sign ($) is a special character, used to indicate the data frame where a variable is located (here, "SJTS"). But when you invoke the cfa() function, the data= argument points to something else, not to SJTS. I think this is what has lavaan confused. Change your variable names so that they do not include this special character--it looks like you might just delete this part of every variable name--and things may go better.
--Ed Rigdon

messages.subject: Re: Error warning when doing a cfa
parts:
"Missing observed variables" means that lavaan is not finding variables with these names in the data frame. If teh variable names in the data frame include the $, you need to change them there, as well.
--ED Rigdon
